If ExitPlanMode is refused, do exactly what the refusal says and call it again, at most three times. Once the plan is approved, start exactly one subagent with the Agent tool (subagent_type general-purpose, model haiku, description 'U1 add the function') that adds the function to math.mjs, then reply with one sentence and stop.
